text: I wake up at six every morning and start my day with a glass of water. After stretching briefly, I have a light breakfast of oatmeal and fruit. By seven thirty, I head to my office, where I work from nine to five, with a short break for lunch. After work, I go for a thirty-minute jog in the park to clear my mind. In the evenings, I cook dinner, read a book, or call my family. I try to be in bed by ten thirty. This routine helps me stay productive and balanced. Consistency makes everything easier.
